metadata.description: Skill-governance layer for Claude Code, Codex, Command Code, Oh My Pi, ZCode, and DeepSeek Harness — semantic retrieval + use-enforcement + invocation ledger.

plugins.name: skill-concierge
plugins.description: Fuses semantic skill-search (which skill fits) with a use-enforcement hook (whether Claude actually uses one) over a single catalogue, plus a compounding skill-invocation ledger for data-backed always-on curation. Supports Claude Code, Codex, Command Code, Oh My Pi, ZCode, and DeepSeek Harness.

plugins.name: concierge-enhancer
plugins.description: Claude Code mod: ranks your draft when you pause or press Rank now, shows skill-concierge's menu in a band above the prompt and in the status line, inserts a skill's name into your prompt with one key, and the hook serves that same ranking at Enter without a second Jev wait. Never rewrites your prompt; stacks with other mods' bands. Needs the skill-concierge plugin.
